Implement Spring Boot 3 / Jakarta entities and Spring Data repositories matching V2 schema:
1. backend/src/main/java/com/kaapstyle/auth/model/RefreshToken.java:

   - Long id, Long userId, String tokenHash, String deviceInfo, Instant expiresAt, boolean isRevoked, Instant createdAt.
2. backend/src/main/java/com/kaapstyle/auth/repository/RefreshTokenRepository.java:

   - List<RefreshToken> findByUserIdAndIsRevokedFalse(Long userId)
